content: The Ateneo School of Medicine and Public Health (ASMPH) is the medical school affiliated with Ateneo de Manila University, a private Roman Catholic institution run by the Society of Jesus in the Philippines. The school is situated within the Eugenio Lopez III Medical Complex in Ortigas Center, Pasig City, adjacent to its partner hospital, The Medical City. The current dean of ASMPH is Dr. Alfredo R. A. Bengzon. The academic program at ASMPH leverages the combined expertise of the Loyola Schools, the Health Unit of the Ateneo Graduate School of Business, and its partner hospital, The Medical City. The curriculum is structured to include a pre-professional phase and a professional phase. The pre-professional phase is integrated with the Health Sciences program offered by the School of Science and Engineering at the Loyola Schools. It is also compatible with other undergraduate degree programs, such as Biology, Psychology, Chemistry, Physics, Medical Technology, Zoology, Economics, and Interdisciplinary Studies, among others, from various institutions. The professional phase of the program is a dual-degree track that culminates in the awarding of both a Doctor of Medicine (MD) degree and a Master of Management (MM) degree. Dr. Alfredo R. A. Bengzon, MD, MBA, serves as the Dean of ASMPH. The Associate Dean is Dr. Maria Eufemia C. Yap, MD, MSc. Dr. Yap earned her Bachelor of Science in Biology from Ateneo in 1983 and completed her medical degree at the Far Eastern University Nicanor Reyes Medical Foundation in 1987. She later pursued a Master of Science in Community Health and Health Management at the University of Heidelberg, graduating in 1997. Dr. Yap has held various roles in Ateneo’s health-related initiatives, including the Center for Community Services (CCS) and the Health Alternatives for Total Human Development Institute (HEALTHDEV). She joined the Ateneo Graduate School of Business (AGSB) as a faculty member and later served as Associate Director and Assistant to the Vice President for the Professional Schools. Since 2003, she has been the Director of the AGSB's Health Unit. Dr. Ma. Luz S. Casimiro-Querubin, MD, FPPA, is the Director for Academic Affairs and Faculty Development. She graduated as valedictorian from Ateneo with a degree in AB Psychology in 1981 and earned her MD from the University of the Philippines in 1987. She became a Diplomate of the Philippine Board of Psychiatry in 1999. Before her current role, Dr. Querubin was an attending psychiatrist in the Department of Psychiatry and Behavioral Medicine at the Philippine General Hospital. She is also a member of the medical staff in the Department of Psychiatry at The Medical City. Additionally, she has served as an Associate Clinical Professor at the College of Medicine, University of the Philippines, a faculty member for Ateneo’s Leaders for Health Program, and a Senior Lecturer in the Department of Psychiatry at the University of Melbourne.
